identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against the current Eufy US shop pages. Robot Vacuum Omni S2, Robot Vacuum E28, Robot Vacuum Omni E25 and Robot Vacuum Omni C20 are four separate current models, each with its own product page and its own station. No new model was created and no company focus was added because Eufy is not a source company with a company-authored focus. The reviewed pages publish current shop prices, so the catalog 1600, 1000 and 699 USD values and the Omni E25 Not disclosed price are replaced. The catalog medium size labels are replaced by the reviewed robot and station dimensions, and the C20 132 min runtime label is replaced by the reviewed 101 min standard runtime. The catalog 180 min S2 battery label and the E28 218 min runtime label are replaced or cleared.

pendingPortfolioLeads.name: Eufy robot net weight and battery capacity in mAh
pendingPortfolioLeads.scope: The Omni S2, E28 and Omni E25 pages publish robot and station dimensions, station water and dust tanks, suction and runtime, but no robot net weight and no battery capacity in mAh. The Omni C20 page publishes a 3,200 mAh battery but no robot net weight and no diameter. These remain unrecorded instead of substituting the catalog values.

pendingPortfolioLeads.name: Eufy travel speed, IP rating and absolute charging time
pendingPortfolioLeads.scope: None of the four reviewed pages publishes a travel speed or an IP protection rating. Only the Omni C20 page publishes an absolute recharge duration of 5.5 hours; the Omni S2, E28 and Omni E25 pages publish no absolute charging time. These remain unrecorded instead of substituting relative statements.

fields.description: The Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni S2 is a vacuum and mop robot featuring 30,000 Pa AeroTurbo 2.0 multi-cyclone suction, a HydroJet 2.0 roller mop with 15 N downward pressure at 240 RPM, and an Omni station with hot-water sterilization. Robot dimensions are 12.79 x 13.66 x 3.78 in (325 x 347 x 96 mm), and station dimensions are 15.08 x 18.39 x 26.38 in. Standard runtime is 150 min for vacuum and mop, and 179 min for vacuum only. It crosses thresholds up to 1.4 in single-layer (1.6 in double-layer) and features RGB camera, LED and 3D TOF obstacle avoidance. The station holds 3 L clean and 2 L dirty water tanks plus a 2.5 L dust bag. Current price is 1,599.99 USD. No robot net weight, battery capacity in mAh, travel speed or IP rating is published; the catalog 1600 USD price, medium size label and 180 min runtime are replaced or cleared.

fields.description: The Eufy Robot Vacuum Omni C20 is an ultra-slim vacuum and mop robot with a body height of 85 mm (3.35 in) designed to glide under low furniture. It delivers 7,000 Pa suction, dual rotating mop pads with 6 N (0.6 kg) downward pressure at 180 RPM, and 10.4 mm mop auto-lifting. A 3,200 mAh battery provides 101 min runtime in standard sweep+mop mode (up to 121 min in quiet mode) with a recharge duration of 5.5 hours. Obstacle avoidance uses infrared and point laser. The all-in-one station auto-empties into a 3.1 L dust bag and holds 2.5 L clean and 2.4 L dirty water tanks. Current price is 699.99 USD. No robot net weight, diameter, travel speed or IP rating is published; the catalog 699 USD price, medium size label and 132 min runtime are replaced or updated.
